# shopify_publications (Data Source)

Lists all sales channel publications of the store, for example to map the `publication_ids` of exported products and collections to names. Same elements as `shopify_publication`; sorted by name, then ID; publications without a name (market catalogs) are left out. Publications belong to sales channel apps and are not managed by this provider. Needs the `read_publications` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All sales channel publications, e.g. to map exported publication_ids to names.
data "shopify_publications" "all" {}

output "publication_names_by_id" {
  value = { for p in data.shopify_publications.all.publications : p.id => p.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `publications` (Attributes List) The publications; an empty list if there are none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--publications))

<a id="nestedatt--publications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `publications`

Read-Only:

- `auto_publish` (Boolean) Whether new products are published to this publication automatically.
- `catalog_id` (String) GID of the catalog the publication belongs to. Null if there is none.
- `id` (String) Publication GID.
- `name` (String) Name of the publication, e.g. `Online Store`.
